# Exact versions of the third-party packages bundled in the downloadable app.
#
# THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt names these versions and licenses/ holds their
# license texts, so the notices shipped with every release must describe
# exactly what is bundled: change a version here, in the notices and in
# licenses/ together. tests/test_release_constraints.py checks that the
# three agree. Used only by .github/workflows/release.yml.

# Qt for Python, LGPL-3.0 (PySide6 is a meta-package for the other two)

PySide6_Addons==6.11.1
shiboken6==6.11.1
